data.name: Survival Town
data.detailed_description:
Survival Town is my very first project as a solo developer, created while learning Unreal Engine. My goal was to build a simple but engaging survival experience where players can explore, gather resources, and shape their own path through a dangerous environment.

In Survival Town, you’ll face a variety of threats, manage limited supplies, and navigate a world where every decision matters. Whether you’re crafting tools, exploring abandoned areas, or fighting to stay alive, your choices determine how long you survive.

This project represents my journey into game development, and I hope players will enjoy the experience as much as I enjoyed creating it.

Features:

• Explore a small handcrafted environment

• Gather resources and survive as long as possible

• Simple combat and exploration mechanics

• Created entirely by a solo developer learning Unreal Engine

Thank you for supporting indie development and first-time creators!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-7400/AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960/AMD Radeon R9 280
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not Supported

  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-9600K/AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1660/RX 580
